messages:
maria: starting network bring-up for bos-gpu2 region. creating a concise validation checklist and runbook snippets. attaching current artifacts here: https://confluence.internal/redwood/bos-bootstrap

akshay: bootstrapping TGW + VPC attachments now. TGW id tgw-bos-01. attaching vpc-bos-core and vpc-bos-gpu. will push routes after attachments are green.

jen: NAT plan: prod -> managed NAT GW per-AZ with EIPs. dev -> NAT instances to save cost. note: NAT GW hourly ~ $0.045 + data egress. we should consider centralized egress for cross-vpc savings.

sam: DNS plan: create private hosted zone bos.redwood.internal. service records: svc-api.bos -> internal NLB. enable split-horizon for peered accounts. remember to set SOA contact and TTL standard values.

maria: quick validation checklist (short):
- TGW attachments show STATUS=available
- Transit route tables have propagate=true for spokes
- No blackhole routes
- Private hosted zone resolves from worker subnets
- NAT EIPs active and appear in S3 access logs for egress ops
- Security groups and NACLs allow 443/443 outbound for telemetry

network-bot: infra-check: vpc-bos-core subnets: private-a(10.200.1.0/24), private-b(10.200.2.0/24), public-a(10.200.101.0/24), public-b(10.200.102.0/24). TGW attachments: tgw-attach-vpc-core=attached, tgw-attach-vpc-gpu=attached. NLBs: created in public-a/b.

akshay: ran `aws ec2 describe-transit-gateway-route-tables --transit-gateway-id tgw-bos-01` -> saw route to 10.200.128.0/17 showing blackhole. looks like missing propagation from vpc-gpu attachment.

jen: blackhole likely due to rt propagation disabled on tgw-rt-01. fix command: `aws ec2 enable-transit-gateway-route-table-propagation --transit-gateway-route-table-id tgw-rt-01 --transit-gateway-attachment-id tgw-attach-vpc-gpu`

akshay: executed enable propagation. re-checking routes... propagation active. retrying internal curl to app: `curl -v http://10.200.1.23:8080/health` -> HTTP/1.1 200 OK.

sam: DNS smoke: `dig +short svc-api.bos.redwood.internal @10.200.0.10` -> 10.200.1.45. metrics cname resolved. added private A records for admin and metrics. add healthcheck TTL to 60s for initial rollout.

maria: egress validation: run `curl -I https://s3.amazonaws.com/health-check -H 'Host: s3.amazonaws.com'` from a worker and check source IP in s3 access log. confirm NAT SNAT behaviour and sticky flow for long-lived connections.

akshay: confirmed. S3 access logs show source IP eip-0abcde1234 -> NAT GW. throughput spot check: sustained ~3Gbps during test window. cost note: projected monthly NAT cost for prod ~ $2.7k across AZs. centralized shared-eip approach might trim $600/mo.

jen: adding runbook snippet for handoff (short):
- Owner: infra-networking (maria)
- TGW id: tgw-bos-01
- Transit RT id: tgw-rt-01
- VPC attachments: tgw-attach-vpc-core, tgw-attach-vpc-gpu
- Private hosted zone id: ZBOSINTERNAL123
- NAT EIP list: eip-0abcde1234, eip-0fghij5678
- Security groups to review: sg-app-workers, sg-nlb
- Rollback: disable propagation on tgw-rt-01 + remove TGW route entries + set DNS TTL back to previous value

maria: tagging enforcement: tag all resources with owner, env, cost-center=infra-gpu. push to compliance scanner after handoff. handing off for final signoff to @platform-oncall :thumbsup:

platform-oncall: signed off for basic bring-up. scheduling formal validation window tomorrow 03:00 UTC. will run the full smoke harness and confirm SLAs. :calendar:

maria: thanks everyone. I'll update the runbook with the exact commands and the little snippets we used here, and close the thread once the formal window passes.
